# The Daring Gourmet

> An international cooking blog exploring world cuisines through authentic recipes from diverse culinary traditions.

The Daring Gourmet is a recipe-focused cooking blog created by Kimberly Killebrew that celebrates global flavors and international cuisine. The site features an extensive collection of recipes spanning cuisines from Germany, Italy, England, Poland, Cuba, and beyond, alongside partnerships with culinary brands.

## Key Topics

- International cuisine
- Recipe collection
- World flavors
- Kimberly Killebrew
- Cooking blog
- Featured recipes
- Holiday cooking
- Food by ingredient
- German cuisine
- Italian cuisine
- Polish cuisine
- Recipe developer
- Homestead living
- Brand partnerships
- Culinary traditions

## Recipe Collection

- [Recipes](https://www.daringgourmet.com/recipes): Comprehensive recipe collection featuring international cuisines including German, British, Italian, and Polish dishes.
- [Homepage](https://www.daringgourmet.com): Featured international recipes including Birria Tacos, Ropa Vieja, and culinary travels around the world.

## About & Author

- [About Me & Press Stuff](https://www.daringgourmet.com/about): Biography of creator Kimberly Killebrew and the story behind The Daring Gourmet cooking blog.

## Contact & Partnerships

- [Work With Me](https://www.daringgourmet.com/work-with-me): Partnership and collaboration opportunities with brands and businesses interested in working with The Daring Gourmet.
